title: Crop disease check
subtitle: Photograph one leaf. The model suggests possible problems; it is not a diagnosis.
unavailable: The disease model is not installed on this server yet.
model: Model {{version}}. Accuracy per crop is published in the evaluation report (admin: AI model performance).

form.tips: For a good result: one leaf filling the frame, in daylight, in focus, on a plain background if possible.
form.tooLarge: The photo is larger than {{mb}} MB.

reason.blank_image: The photo looks blank. Please photograph a leaf.
reason.too_dark: The photo is too dark. Take it in daylight.
reason.overexposed: The photo is too bright. Avoid direct glare.
reason.too_blurry: The photo is blurry. Hold the phone steady and focus on the leaf.
reason.not_a_supported_leaf: This does not look like a leaf of a supported crop. Retake the photo, or ask an expert.
reason.low_confidence: The model is not sure. Compare the possibilities below, take another photo, or ask an expert.
reason.looks_like_other_crop: This leaf looks like a different crop from the one you chose. Check the crop, or ask an expert.

result.title: Result
result.chemical: Chemical options listed in the official IPM package
result.chemicalWithheld: Chemical options are shown only when the model is confident.
result.englishOnly: Details are in English for now.

ask.sent: Sent to an expert with the photo and the model's top 3.
